text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I had to win… But this…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her clenched fists tremble slightly. This losing streak seems to be taking a toll on her.
choice_data_list: This isn't the time to be feeling down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her clenched fists tremble slightly. This losing streak seems to be taking a toll on her.
choice_data_list: This isn't the time to be feeling down!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You blindly believing in me doesn't help.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: But… there also isn't any point in me being depressed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I have to take a deeper look at myself and find out what I'm missing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Along with that, I'll need to rethink my training routine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Right. Let me know if you have any ideas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I work with Admire Vega to devise a new training routine.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I have to think about what I can do to win, which means thinking back and finding the problems I've had in past races.
choice_data_list: We can figure that out together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega and I go over past races in preparation for her next one.
